title: LA Memorial Coliseum: first stadium show
story: His first stadium show. Fred played from six spots and walked a moat around the field; Obongjayar sang from the stands among the fans, Romy and Fred started Strong facing each other, and he had an MPC battle with Tony across the moat. Sound engineer Jamie Tinsley picked a stadium without a roof, so the cheers would not bounce back, and ringed the stage with subs so nobody was more than 60 metres from a speaker.
